recommendations.title: Missing or poorly sized meta description
recommendations.action: Add a unique, relevant meta description (150-160 chars).

recommendations.title: Missing or multiple H1 tags
recommendations.action: Add a single <h1> containing your primary keyword.

recommendations.title: Not using HTTPS
recommendations.action: Enable HTTPS and redirect all traffic to HTTPS.

recommendations.title: Missing DOCTYPE declaration
recommendations.action: Add <!DOCTYPE html> at the start of every HTML document.

recommendations.title: Slow server response time (TTFB)
recommendations.action: Reduce server response time (optimize queries, use caching, CDN).

recommendations.title: Images missing alt text
recommendations.action: Add descriptive alt text to images missing it.

recommendations.title: Images missing width/height dimensions
recommendations.action: Specify width/height attributes to prevent Cumulative Layout Shift.

recommendations.title: Generic or non-descriptive anchor text
recommendations.action: Replace generic anchor text (e.g. 'click here') with descriptive text.

recommendations.title: Missing canonical URL
recommendations.action: Add <link rel='canonical'> to the preferred URL.

recommendations.title: Missing schema markup
recommendations.action: Add JSON-LD structured data for key page types.

recommendations.title: Missing structured data / schema markup
recommendations.action: Add Schema.org JSON-LD markup to enable rich results.

recommendations.title: Thin or overly long content
recommendations.action: Expand thin pages to at least 300 words of useful content.

recommendations.title: Illogical heading hierarchy
recommendations.action: Organize headings in a logical H1→H2→H3 hierarchy.

recommendations.title: Missing Open Graph tags
recommendations.action: Add required Open Graph meta tags for social sharing.

recommendations.title: Missing or inconsistent www canonicalization
recommendations.action: Choose one canonical host (www or non-www) and 301-redirect the other to it.
